Office microwave beeping after midnight causes alert fatigue

Impact: Multiple employees on late shifts and on-call have reported the kitchen microwave emits a periodic beep after its timer completes, often past midnight. Observed behavior: The microwave beeps 3-5 times at varying intervals (5-20s) and occasionally repeats the cycle after a short pause. Steps to reproduce: 1) Heat food for 1:00 minute after 23:00 2) Wait for timer; 3) Observe beep sequence. Logs/notes: Facilities log 2025-11-03 notes 'sticky button' replaced but issue resurfaced. Janitorial reported no firmware updates. Temporary workaround: unplug microwave overnight or place a handwritten sign asking to mute. Request: coordinate with procurement for replacement or pursue manufacturer firmware/mute setting. Owner: Facilities
